tracks.title: Original track
tracks.description: Text and structured-state decisions using Choice, Noul, and Score, from single judgments to evaluated workflows and simulations.

tracks.title: Multimodal track
tracks.description: Experimental image judgments, visual reference matching, Box localization, ordered still-frame analysis, and multimodal long-context evaluation.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.scope: One bounded judgment over a short prepared input with direct inspection of typed results.

levels.name: Easy
levels.scope: Context-sensitive matching, scoring, or verification with candidate sets and explicit uncertain or no-match outcomes.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.scope: Multiple judgments or stages, structured evidence, deterministic composition, and task-level evaluation.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.scope: Stateful workflows, provenance, adversarial cases, model calibration, or several integrated decision stages.

levels.name: Expert
levels.scope: Controlled optimization studies or closed-loop simulations requiring budgets, baselines, and held-out or trajectory evaluation.

sources.supports: Typed questions over supplied state and atomic judgments composed in code.
Choice, Noul, Score, independent questions, and dependent follow-up calls.
Distribution-derived confidence and task-specific thresholds informed by observed outcomes.

sources.reference: TypeSafe AI: How to build with TypeSafe
sources.supports: Narrow semantic judgments integrated with workflows, deterministic logic, and side effects controlled by code.
Application families covering classification, routing, scoring, retrieval, and verification.
Worked patterns for extraction, citation checking, skill selection, hierarchical classification, and feature discovery.
Version-specific limitations affecting arithmetic, context selection, adversarial content, and generation.
A typed interface for comparing Jev with decision adapters backed by generative models.
Experimental PNG/JPEG assets in state, instructions, and criteria; image comparisons and ordered still frames with the images header.
Jev 1.14 single-target bounding rectangles, normalized edges and confidence, absent-target checks, tiled search, and crop verification.

sources.reference: TypeSafe AI: Models and long context
sources.supports: Versioned model IDs, moving aliases, and opt-in 262k-token per-request and per-question context for Jev 1.13 and 1.14.
The October 14, 2026 release of Jev 1.14 and the experimental status of image, Box, and long-context capabilities.

recipes.title: Sentiment classification
recipes.use_case: Classify a short customer review as positive, neutral, negative, or mixed using a fixed set of labels.

recipes.title: Refund intent detection
recipes.use_case: Judge whether a customer message explicitly requests a refund so Python can flag it for the appropriate workflow.

recipes.title: Response clarity scoring
recipes.use_case: Score a support response against a clearly defined clarity rubric to identify examples that need editing.

recipes.title: Support ticket routing
recipes.use_case: Assign a support ticket to a fixed service category or an unclear-request outcome using its subject and description.

recipes.title: Document classification
recipes.use_case: Classify a short document as an invoice, meeting note, policy, technical guide, or other document type from its text.

recipes.title: Multiple topic labels
recipes.use_case: Tag customer feedback with every applicable topic by asking an independent yes-or-no question for each predefined label.

recipes.title: Word sense selection
recipes.use_case: Select the intended meaning of an ambiguous word from a fixed sense inventory using its surrounding sentence.

recipes.title: FAQ selection
recipes.use_case: Select the best matching FAQ from a short candidate list, including a no-match outcome when none addresses the question.

recipes.title: File organization
recipes.use_case: Recommend a destination folder from a fixed catalog using a file's name and text excerpt so Python can preview the proposed organization.

recipes.title: Answer relevance check
recipes.use_case: Judge whether a candidate response addresses the user's question so a notebook can separate relevant answers from off-topic replies.

recipes.title: Clarification selection
recipes.use_case: Select a useful follow-up question from a predefined catalog when a task description omits information needed for the next step.

recipes.title: Thesaurus word selection
recipes.use_case: Choose a context-appropriate synonym from a supplied thesaurus list while retaining the original word when no alternative preserves its meaning.

recipes.title: Candidate rewrite selection
recipes.use_case: Choose a supplied sentence rewrite that preserves the original meaning and requested tone, with a no-suitable-rewrite outcome when necessary.

recipes.title: Source span selection
recipes.use_case: Select the supplier name from text spans already extracted by Python, with a not-stated outcome when the document lacks that field.

recipes.title: Sensitive text triage
recipes.use_case: Flag synthetic documents that may contain personal information so a simulated review queue can prioritize redaction checks.

recipes.title: Discord moderation triage
recipes.use_case: Classify sample Discord messages as allowed, review-needed, or potentially violating a supplied community rule to populate a simulated moderator queue.

recipes.title: Passage reranking
recipes.use_case: Score retrieved passages against a question so Python can rank candidate evidence and retain each passage's source reference.

recipes.title: Duplicate incident matching
recipes.use_case: Select a matching incident from a retrieved ticket shortlist, or no match, using descriptions of the symptoms and affected service.

recipes.title: CI failure classification
recipes.use_case: Classify recorded continuous-integration failures as test regressions, dependency problems, infrastructure failures, or unknown to select the next diagnostic workflow.

recipes.title: Claim support classification
recipes.use_case: Classify whether a provided passage supports, contradicts, or leaves unresolved a specific claim while preserving the passage identifier.

recipes.title: Quiz answer adjudication
recipes.use_case: Judge whether a typed quiz response matches an accepted answer by meaning, with partial-match and review outcomes for ambiguous responses.

recipes.title: CMDB asset matching
recipes.use_case: Link differently worded software asset descriptions to a canonical configuration-management record from a bounded candidate list or a no-match outcome.

recipes.title: Pairwise answer evaluation
recipes.use_case: Compare two candidate answers against one explicit rubric criterion while retaining tie and insufficient-evidence outcomes for evaluation against human labels.

recipes.title: Incident priority composition
recipes.use_case: Score reported business impact and urgency against separate rubrics so Python can map the scores to defined categories and apply a fixed service-priority matrix.

recipes.title: Change evidence review
recipes.use_case: Check whether a proposed change includes sufficient implementation, validation, and rollback evidence so a deterministic checklist can identify review gaps.

recipes.title: Prompt-injection screening
recipes.use_case: Flag instruction-redirection attempts in retrieved text using adversarial and benign quotation fixtures to measure false positives and missed attacks.

recipes.title: Function selection
recipes.use_case: Select a function from a preapproved catalog for a request while Python validates supplied arguments before simulated execution.

recipes.title: Skill selection
recipes.use_case: Score retrieved skill descriptions for relevance to a task so Python can select a suitable skill or request clarification.

recipes.title: Tool outcome verification
recipes.use_case: Classify recorded tool outcomes as complete, partial, failed, or unverifiable using the original request and observed evidence.

recipes.title: Citation verification
recipes.use_case: Check each answer claim against its cited passage and flag unsupported or contradicted claims while Python verifies citation identifiers.

recipes.title: Patch risk triage
recipes.use_case: Assess a small patch for separate authentication, input-validation, and data-loss concerns to prioritize human review using explicit rules.

recipes.title: Regression test selection
recipes.use_case: Score candidate tests against the behavior changed by a patch so Python can propose a focused regression suite.

recipes.title: Schema field mapping
recipes.use_case: Map source field descriptions to a bounded target schema with ambiguous and unmapped outcomes before Python validates the proposed mappings.

recipes.title: Evidence relationship labels
recipes.use_case: Label candidate entity pairs with an allowed relationship type or no-supported-relation using provided evidence passages.

recipes.title: Semantic feature extraction
recipes.use_case: Convert text into predefined semantic features with independent judgments and compare a classifier trained on those features with a fixed baseline.

recipes.title: Card-game action selection
recipes.use_case: Select a legal action in a turn-based card-game simulator using structured state and fixed action descriptions while Python enforces game rules.

recipes.title: Research domain tagging
recipes.use_case: Assign independently judged research-domain labels to evidence passages while Python preserves provenance and enforces access controls.

recipes.title: Abstention and review queues
recipes.use_case: Route uncertain ticket classifications to review using thresholds selected from validation examples and measure accuracy versus coverage on a held-out set.

recipes.title: Document extraction cascade
recipes.use_case: Select candidate values for document fields, verify each selection against its source span, and route uncertain or inconsistent records to review.

recipes.title: Hierarchical classification
recipes.use_case: Route documents through a taxonomy in stages while Python carries competing branches forward when early judgments are uncertain.

recipes.title: Approval scope review
recipes.use_case: Flag semantic mismatches between an approved task and a proposed tool action while Python enforces exact permissions and approval bindings.

recipes.title: Outbound disclosure screening
recipes.use_case: Screen proposed outbound messages for disclosure concerns against supplied sharing rules while deterministic controls hold flagged or uncertain samples for review.

recipes.title: Failure recovery selection
recipes.use_case: Select retry, alternative method, or escalation from a bounded recovery catalog using execution history while Python enforces retry budgets and stop conditions.

recipes.title: Plan constraint assessment
recipes.use_case: Evaluate each candidate plan against individual user constraints so deterministic policy can reject ineligible plans and route unresolved judgments to review.

recipes.title: Memory reconciliation
recipes.use_case: Classify a new memory statement as corroborating, superseding, contradicting, or unrelated to existing evidence so a versioned store can preserve provenance and unresolved conflicts.

recipes.title: Semantic context paging
recipes.use_case: Judge stored context chunks for relevance to the current task so Python can retain, page out, or rehydrate them while preserving original content and source links.

recipes.title: Evidence conflict diagnosis
recipes.use_case: Classify apparent claim conflicts by factual disagreement, time, entity, or scope using source excerpts and temporal relationships already computed by Python.

recipes.title: Document revision consistency
recipes.use_case: Select among externally supplied sentence revisions and check their consistency with paragraph context as Python assembles a versioned document.

recipes.title: Multi-agent task assignment
recipes.use_case: Score each agent's suitability for a subtask so a deterministic scheduler can assign work under capability, dependency, and budget constraints.

recipes.title: Model comparison and calibration
recipes.use_case: Compare Jev and alternative decision backends on identical labeled tasks, calibrating each model separately and measuring held-out quality, latency, and cost.

recipes.title: Stalled-loop detection
recipes.use_case: Classify progress across recorded agent turns as advancing, repeating, regressing, or complete so Python can apply a continue, change-strategy, or stop policy.

recipes.title: Retrieval pipeline evaluation
recipes.use_case: Combine passage filtering, reranking, and claim verification in a retrieval pipeline and measure each stage's effect on answer support using a fixed labeled corpus.

recipes.title: Semantic feature discovery
recipes.use_case: Judge text against externally proposed semantic features, select a feature set through a budgeted validation search, and evaluate the frozen downstream classifier on an untouched test set.

recipes.title: Question and policy optimization
recipes.use_case: Optimize Jev question wording, criteria, and decision thresholds with an external search loop, then compare frozen variants on an untouched test set.

recipes.title: Adaptive model routing
recipes.use_case: Use Jev judgments to drive a model-routing policy and compare quality, latency, and cost across traffic mixes while Python enforces budgets and fallback rules.

recipes.title: Adversarial harness evaluation
recipes.use_case: Evaluate Jev screening at input, retrieved-context, proposed-action, and output boundaries using adversarial replay while measuring attack success, false positives, and task completion.

recipes.title: Evidence graph updates
recipes.use_case: Combine entity, relationship, and evidence judgments into a proposed graph update that Python validates and applies transactionally in a simulated store with replayable provenance.

recipes.title: Simulated process supervision
recipes.use_case: Select supervisory responses to simulated PLC fault descriptions and telemetry while Python enforces interlocks and a separate controller handles timing and actuation.

recipes.title: Observation and action selection
recipes.use_case: Choose the next permitted observation and subsequent legal action in a partially observed game, then compare complete trajectories with a rule-based baseline.

recipes.title: Factory production control
recipes.use_case: Select bounded production goals and recovery actions from structured factory state while a Factorio-style simulator executes predefined action templates and measures throughput, stalls, and resource use.

recipes.title: Screenshot error-state recognition
recipes.use_case: Classify an application screenshot as a crash, loading state, authentication failure, normal operation, or unknown using fixed visual categories.

recipes.title: Visual regression detection
recipes.use_case: Compare before-and-after screenshots for missing elements, misalignment, clipping, and other predefined visual changes, then score each change against an explicit severity rubric.

recipes.title: Manufacturing defect inspection
recipes.use_case: Check synthetic product photographs for scratches, dents, missing components, and incorrect assembly with independent judgments and a defined defect-severity rubric.

recipes.title: Field maintenance photo triage
recipes.use_case: Classify predefined equipment conditions in maintenance photographs and independently flag visible corrosion, leaks, or disconnected cabling for a simulated review queue.

recipes.title: Retail shelf compliance
recipes.use_case: Compare shelf photographs with an approved planogram image using independent checks for misplaced or missing product groups while Python combines the findings.

recipes.title: Technical schematic recognition
recipes.use_case: Identify a predefined circuit, wiring, or infrastructure symbol from a cropped schematic image, retaining an unknown outcome for ambiguous or unlisted symbols.

recipes.title: Product finish verification
recipes.use_case: Compare a product photograph with a visual reference using separate color, material, and finish checks and explicit similarity rubrics under controlled imaging conditions.

recipes.title: Visual accessibility screening
recipes.use_case: Flag apparent text clipping, low contrast, crowding, and overlapping UI components with independent screenshot judgments to identify candidates for further accessibility testing.

recipes.title: Visual SKU recognition
recipes.use_case: Select a product variant from a fixed SKU catalog whose choice criteria contain reference photographs, with no-match and uncertain outcomes.

recipes.title: Brand identity verification
recipes.use_case: Compare a displayed logo or marketing asset with an approved reference image using bounded visual conformity checks and route uncertain results to review.

recipes.title: Golden-sample assembly checks
recipes.use_case: Score an assembly photograph against rubric levels illustrated by good and defective reference examples so Python can identify candidates for inspection.

recipes.title: Board-game piece recognition
recipes.use_case: Identify a token, tile, figurine, or card from fixed categories defined by reference images, including an unknown outcome for unseen or ambiguous pieces.

recipes.title: Visual UI state identification
recipes.use_case: Classify a cropped UI component as selected, disabled, active, hovered, error, or unknown using visual examples in each choice criterion.

recipes.title: Material swatch matching
recipes.use_case: Match a textile, paint, flooring, or material photograph to a controlled collection of visual swatches, with no-match and uncertain outcomes for appearance ambiguity.

recipes.title: Generated-art style consistency
recipes.use_case: Score a generated illustration against separate art-direction criteria illustrated by a supplied moodboard, using explicit rubric levels and retaining each criterion score.

recipes.title: Plant appearance matching
recipes.use_case: Compare a plant photograph with labeled visual examples to suggest a candidate appearance group, including unknown for unsupported or ambiguous matches.

recipes.title: Visual browser element locator
recipes.use_case: Locate a named button, form input, or menu item in a screenshot and check target presence before Python draws the rectangle and previews a simulated browser action.

recipes.title: Signature and stamp localization
recipes.use_case: Check whether a synthetic scanned document contains a requested signature or approval stamp and locate one matching region for Python to crop and evaluate.

recipes.title: Engineering diagram component locator
recipes.use_case: Check for and locate a specified valve, connector, or symbol on an engineering diagram while Python converts normalized box edges into a visible annotation.

recipes.title: Game HUD perception
recipes.use_case: Identify and locate a requested energy meter, card, action button, or enemy indicator in a synthetic screenshot of an invented, unbranded deck-building game HUD, with absent and ambiguous outcomes before any simulated action.

recipes.title: Defect localization
recipes.use_case: Check for one specified visible scratch, dent, or broken component, then draw and evaluate its bounding rectangle while suppressing boxes for absent targets.

recipes.title: Reference-guided object search
recipes.use_case: Locate a particular product on a cluttered shelf or workbench using its reference photo in the instructions, with an independent presence check before accepting the rectangle.

recipes.title: Hierarchical visual search
recipes.use_case: Select among Python-generated image tiles, retaining no-match and uncertain outcomes, then progressively localize a small target while Python maps the final rectangle back to the full image.

recipes.title: Bounding-box self-verification
recipes.use_case: Check target presence, localize it, and ask independent questions about whether it continues past each crop edge so Python can adjust the rectangle within fixed retry and size limits.

recipes.title: Door state transition detection
recipes.use_case: Classify a door as opened, closed, unchanged, or uncertain across chronologically ordered PNG or JPEG frames sampled by Python.

recipes.title: Object arrival/departure detection
recipes.use_case: Determine whether a specified package, vehicle, or other object appeared, disappeared, remained, or is uncertain across ordered still frames of a scene.

recipes.title: Game phase transition detection
recipes.use_case: Recognize transitions between combat, menus, map selection, and rewards from ordered game screenshots while Python records the phase history and handles uncertain transitions.

recipes.title: Visual action verification
recipes.use_case: Compare screenshots before and after a simulated browser action to judge whether the intended UI change is visible while Python preserves the action and frame records.

recipes.title: Conveyor jam detection
recipes.use_case: Evaluate ordered synthetic factory frames for visible blockage or halted conveyor movement and score the evidence using a fixed rubric while Python controls sampling and timing.

recipes.title: Assembly progression recognition
recipes.use_case: Identify the predefined assembly stage reached in a chronological photograph sequence, retaining unknown or inconsistent outcomes for review.

recipes.title: Sports action phase recognition
recipes.use_case: Classify a short ordered still-image sequence as preparation, execution, recovery, or an unrecognized movement using supplied phase definitions.

recipes.title: Video highlight candidate detection
recipes.use_case: Score frame sequences for separately defined highlight signals such as visible reactions or unusual scene changes while Python samples video and maps candidate windows to timestamps.

recipes.title: Image-grounded bug report verification
recipes.use_case: Check whether a screenshot supports each claimed bug symptom using the description, error logs, and expected behavior, preserving evidence links for a simulated review queue.

recipes.title: Long-form visual evidence audit
recipes.use_case: Compare inspection photographs with individual statements in an extended report or maintenance history using opt-in long context while Python preserves evidence provenance and review outcomes.

recipes.title: AI livestream overlay verification
recipes.use_case: Compare gameplay frames and recorded agent state with displayed strategy, phase, and action overlays to flag unsupported status claims in a simulated livestream review.

recipes.title: Multilingual visual instruction verification
recipes.use_case: Classify whether photographs and signage support instructions across languages, comparing pinned Jev 1.13 and 1.14 versions on identical labeled tasks with an uncertain outcome.

recipes.title: Photo-based equipment troubleshooting
recipes.use_case: Combine a photographed symptom, equipment model information, and a long troubleshooting manual to select candidate diagnostic checks from a supplied catalog for simulated review.

recipes.title: Long-context versus focused-context evaluation
recipes.use_case: Compare judgments using contexts up to the opt-in 262k-token limit with retrieval and staged decisions across all four decision types on identical labeled tasks, with frozen policies, held-out evaluation, and measured resource use.

recipes.title: Historical screenshot sequence analysis
recipes.use_case: Check candidate state transitions against a long sequence of screenshots and textual test logs so Python can identify the earliest supported visible transition associated with a defect.

recipes.title: Multimodal agent handoff verification
recipes.use_case: Classify a reported agent result and independently check its claims against screenshots and tool records before deterministic policy permits a simulated handoff or requests review.
